title: Government of India notifies 11 more International Ports, enabling entry of E-Visa holder foreigners into India
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Home Affairs

Government of India notifies 11 more International Ports, enabling entry of E-Visa holder foreigners into India

Total number of International Ports for E-Visa holder foreigners’ entry now goes up to 88
Addition of 11 International Ports further enhances attractiveness and utility of electronic visa, India provides approximately 95% E-visas applications in less than 72 hours
Under guidance of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi and leadership of Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah, Government has taken a number of significant initiatives over the last few years to liberalize, streamline and simplify visa regime

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
10 AUG 2026 5:43PM by PIB Delhi

The Government of India has notified 11 more International Ports, enabling E-visa holder foreigners to enter India. The newly added 11 International Ports include 09 land ports and 02 airports. Addition of 11 International Ports further enhances attractiveness and utility of electronic visa. Notably, India provides approximately 95% E-visas applications in less than 72 hours.

Under the guidance of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi and leadership of Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah, Government of India has taken a number of significant initiatives over the last few years to liberalize, streamline and simplify visa regime with a view to facilitate the legitimate foreign travelers while simultaneously ramping up the technological infrastructure to enhance internal security.

With the latest addition, the total number of International Ports enabling entry of E-Visa holder foreigners has increased to 88, including 37 airports, 38 seaports and 13 land ports.

E-VISA

One significant step taken to liberalize and simplify the Indian Visa regime, especially the tourist visa regime, is the introduction of the e-Visa facility. E-visa facility, with Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA), was introduced in 2014 for nationals of 43 countries. This facility is presently available to nationals of 172 countries.
